pitfalls: Weight storage does not set the GPU compute precision: request GpuOptions(precision = FP32). At the default precision the outputs stay finite but the answers move: Galaxy S26 475/482 top labels and 455/482 label sets, Mac Metal 479/469 (card 'Galaxy S26, gate app' and 'fp16, the GPU default precision and the NPU').

The graph takes host-built inputs: inputs_embeds [1,128,384] from host_assets/tok_embeddings_fp16.bin ([50370,384] float16 rows upcast to float32, [PAD] 50283 rows at padded positions), attention_mask [1,128] (1 real / 0 pad), label_routing [1,25,128] (row k = 1 at the k-th <<LABEL>> token); output logits [1,1,1,25], slots past the request's labels are ignored; softmax (single-label) or sigmoid >= threshold (multi-label) runs on the host (card 'Host contract').

The request string is <<LABEL>>label 1<<LABEL>>label 2…<<SEP>> + prompt + text with nothing between the prompt and the text; tokenize with the source tokenizer.json ([CLS] … [SEP], ByteLevel prefix space per piece between added tokens); at most 25 labels and 128 tokens, longer requests raise an error, nothing is truncated (card 'Host contract', 'Limits').

Size option, not the default: on the 552 test requests the float16-weight graphs change 2 near-tie answers (banking77_015, top-2 logits 0.0012 apart; banking77_064, one sigmoid 0.0002 below 0.5) that the float32-weight graphs keep, because the converter folds each LayerNorm scale into the next FULLY_CONNECTED weights and float16 rounds those products by up to 7.7e-4 (card 'fp16, the GPU default precision and the NPU').

The shipped graph computes 15 LayerNorms on x*2^-k with eps*2^-2k (k = 5 in layers 3-6, 6 in layers 7-9 and the final norm) and uses a -1e4 mask; this is exact in FP32 (bit-identical logits to the unmodified graph) and keeps fp16 computation finite but not exact: the Galaxy S26 Hexagon NPU (JIT, one partition, 2.51 ms) keeps 480/482 top labels and 462/482 label sets, every change a near tie, so the card reports the NPU and does not call it a validated path (card 'fp16, the GPU default precision and the NPU').
The checkpoint is float32: the float16 host table rounds values by up to 1.2e-4 (max logit difference 0.0090 against 0.000036 with a float32 table, same answers on all 552 requests) (card 'fp16 …').

Validated on one desktop (Apple M4 Max, ai-edge-litert 2.1.6 CPU and Metal explicit FP32) and one phone (Galaxy S26, LiteRT 2.2.0 GPU explicit FP32 and CPU); English only; conversion fidelity to the official gliclass pipeline (552/552 answers), not a task-accuracy claim — own-subset gold agreement 67/144 SemIf, 115/200 ag_news, 71/200 banking77 (25-way) is not the publisher's benchmark (card 'Agreement with the dataset labels', 'Limits').
